updates.title: Added 30 new sounds and 2 categories
updates.description: The catalog now includes 65 sounds. Discover the new 'Magic / Fantasy' and 'Environment' categories, along with 10 '002' variants of existing sounds. The home page now displays the live counter.

updates.title: Added donate button
updates.description: A 'Donate' button has been added to the footer to prepare for future project support.

updates.title: Added 10 new sounds
updates.description: The catalog expands with 10 additional sounds, bringing the total to 35 original sounds.

updates.title: Improved search and filters
updates.description: Search is now smarter (handling accents, multi-words), and a sorting system has been added to the Sounds page.
